_note: The seven DLC Bracelets. A Bracelet is one Emblem that carries several heroes: the owned-Emblem record (GOD) points at one hero's god id, while the bond record (GDBD) is filed under another. The Three Houses entry is read straight from a real save - GOD said GID_ディミトリ, GDBD said GID_エーデルガルト - and its bond-holder ids are the seven DLC entries in emblems.json, so lookup works from either side. Names are the game's own English labels.
